subject: IAM evidence and follow-up from today's discovery call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@veridianhealth.com>, security@veridianhealth.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: IAM evidence and follow-up from today's discovery call

Hi Alice / Veridian security team —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and the items we discussed so we can move toward a scoped security review and implementation plan: 

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II is in progress with a target completion in Q3; please share any interim audit statements, attestation letters, or a SOC 2 status memo if available.

2) SSO / SAML: we need IdP metadata (XML), ACS URL, Entity ID, and any IdP-initiated/ SP-initiated details.

3) SCIM provisioning: sample SCIM schema, allowed attributes, provisioning flows (one-way vs two-way), and whether you support bulk provisioning.

4) RBAC & admin controls: list of built-in roles, ability to create custom roles, admin separation (super-admin, billing, app-admin), and how admin actions are logged.

5) Audit logs & retention: length of retention for auth events, admin actions, and how logs are exported (SIEM integration / S3 / syslog).

6) Vendor security questionnaire: please attach the completed questionnaire or indicate the format you prefer (we attached a short checklist on our side).

Proposed next steps: if you can send the items above by end of day Thursday we can route to our security review and schedule a technical SSO/SCIM call next week (Ethan to lead). If SOC 2 artifacts will take longer, a short note on expected delivery dates is fine.

Thanks again — appreciate the collaborative call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood_iam_checklist.pdf (overview checklist)

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@veridianhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@veridianhealth.com, Bob Nguyen <bob.nguyen@veridianhealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T17:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: IAM evidence and follow-up from today's discovery call

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Attached is our completed vendor questionnaire and our IdP metadata export. A few notes inline:

- SOC 2: we completed readiness in Jan and engaged an auditor; Type II is on track for completion by 2027-08-15. We can provide a SOC 2 status memo and scope summary now; full report will be after the audit is complete.

- SSO/SAML: attached veridian_sso_metadata.xml. We support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SAML flows. ACS URL and Entity ID are included in the metadata.

- SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 for user lifecycle (create/update/deactivate). I attached a sample payload and schema (scim_sample_payload.json).

- RBAC: we have default roles (admin, user, viewer) and can scope custom role creation for enterprise accounts. We log admin role changes and critical admin actions; retention is 12 months for auth logs, 3 years for security audit logs.

Attachments: veridian_vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx; veridian_sso_metadata.xml; scim_sample_payload.json

Let us know when you'd like to schedule the technical call — next Tue/Wed mornings PST work for our team.

Best,
Alice Chen
Director of IT Security
Veridian Health
alice.chen@veridianhealth.com

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: IAM evidence and follow-up from today's discovery call

Alice —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and attachments. A few follow-ups and asks so our security and infra teams can validate compatibility: 

- Can you confirm SCIM provisioning supports the following attributes at minimum: userName, givenName, familyName, emails, externalId, active. A sample create and update payload (you included one — thanks) is perfect; can you also include a sample deactivate (PATCH) payload?

- For SAML, can you confirm whether you require any specific NameID format (email vs persistent) and whether you send groups in the assertion (we can map to RBAC if present).

- For RBAC, can you include a short doc or spreadsheet listing role permissions (i.e., what admin can do vs viewer).

- For SOC 2, the status memo and expected delivery date is sufficient for now — if you can share the auditor name and scope that helps expedite our legal review.

I'll coordinate scheduling: Ethan, can you propose 30–45m on Tue/Wed morning PST? Also Aditya — I'm looping you for technical security review and to define the exact evidence we'll need for procurement.

Thanks — attaching the Redwood IAM checklist (redwood_iam_checklist.pdf) to show what our security team looks for.

Best,
Marissa

--
Attachments: redwood_iam_checklist.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Veridian IAM follow-ups

Marissa — thanks for the thread. A few internal notes we should capture before the technical call: 

- Ask for explicit IdP SAML metadata fields: EntityID, ACS URL(s), SingleLogout URL, NameID formats supported, and sample assertion including group/role claims.

- Request SCIM: sample POST (create), PUT/PATCH (update), and PATCH deactivate. Also ask for rate limits and bulk provisioning endpoints.

- RBAC: we need a role->permission mapping (spreadsheet). Important to confirm whether role assignments are manageable via SCIM (i.e., groups->roles mapping).

- Audit logs: we should request a sample event log export (anonymized) and confirm retention policy and export mechanisms (SIEM integration or S3).

- Compliance artifacts: SOC 2 status memo + auditor contact, ISO or GDPR DPA if applicable. If they are HIPAA-covered, ask for BAAs — confirm verbally if healthcare data will be routed.

I'll draft a short technical checklist to send on the call and can run the artifacts through our procurement intake.

Aditya Rao
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
